after2_start.name: {name}
after2_start.text: *After school. Two notifications are waiting on my phone.*

after2_msg_dain.name: Dain
after2_msg_dain.text: Come to the gym. Today's bet is for real.

after2_msg_seo.name: Seoyeon
after2_msg_seo.text: Can you swing by the council room? I'm short-handed.

after2_msg_yuna.name: {name}
after2_msg_yuna.text: *I haven't heard from Yuna. As I pack my bag, the note from this morning slips out of my pocket. The words 'Library annex' straddle the crease.*

after2_nurse_transition.name: {name}
after2_nurse_transition.text: *After fifth-period PE, the edge of the bandage catches on my sleeve. I press it down once, but it lifts again.*

hidden_nurse_d2_1.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d2_1.text: *When I roll up my sleeve, one side of the bandage is peeling up. The wound isn't bleeding anymore.*

hidden_nurse_d2_2.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d2_2.text: That bandage came back before the day was even over. Have a seat.

hidden_nurse_d2_3.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d2_3.text: The edge keeps catching on my sleeve.

hidden_nurse_d2_5.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d2_5.text: *She removes the loose bandage, cleans around the wound, and takes out a fresh one.* This might sting a little.

hidden_nurse_d2_choice1.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d2_choice1.text: *The nurse bends and straightens my elbow, measuring how long the bandage should be.*
choices: Did you learn things like this at the hospital?
You even pay attention to the angle.

hidden_nurse_d2_choice1_a.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d2_choice1_a.text: Yeah. Over a joint, you have to apply it so movement won't peel it off.

hidden_nurse_d2_choice1_b.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d2_choice1_b.text: It's my job. If I slap it on carelessly and it falls off in class, that's a problem.

hidden_nurse_d2_6.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d2_6.text: *As I check the bandage, I notice a pale green notebook jutting out of the desk drawer. The first line on the open page reads, 'To you, that day—' The nurse closes the drawer.*

hidden_nurse_d2_7.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d2_7.text: *She closes the drawer.* You didn't see that, right? ...Never mind. Let's talk about the paperwork.

hidden_nurse_d2_choice2.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d2_choice2.text: *She says it's a secret, laughing — but her eyes aren't laughing.*
choices: You sure have a lot of secrets. Can't you tell me just one?

hidden_nurse_d2_choice2_a.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d2_choice2_a.text: *She narrows her eyes.* Just one? ...Fine. I like cocoa more than coffee. That's the secret.

hidden_nurse_d2_choice2_b.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d2_choice2_b.text: *She laughs softly.* A secret. That's enough, right?

hidden_nurse_d2_8.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d2_8.text: All done. Keep it dry today.

hidden_nurse_d2_9.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d2_9.text: *After being told to come back if the bandage lifts or blood seeps through, I leave the nurse's office.*

after2_dain_1.name: {name}
after2_dain_1.text: *The gym. Dain is doing warm-ups in front of the volleyball net.*

after2_dain_4.name: Dain
after2_dain_4.text: I got here ten minutes early!

after2_dain_5.name: {name}
after2_dain_5.text: *You're the one who came early. I wasn't late.*

after2_dain_6.name: Dain
after2_dain_6.text: Okay, deal! Five serves — clear the net at least three times and you win! Lose, and you're buying tteokbokki!

after2_dain_9.name: {name}
after2_dain_9.text: *The first serve catches the net. The second lands inside the line.*

after2_dain_9_b.name: Dain
after2_dain_9_b.text: *Eyes widening* Huh? I was gonna go easy, but never mind.

after2_dain_9_c.name: Dain
after2_dain_9_c.text: *She lowers her stance and tightens her grip on the ball.*

after2_dain_9_e.name: {name}
after2_dain_9_e.text: *Rally after rally. Fast, precise — but she puts more weight on her left leg each landing. She's avoiding her right side.*

after2_dain_9_f.name: {name}
after2_dain_9_f.text: *The scoreboard reads 3–2. I win by a hair. As Dain stands, she rubs her right knee once. She's still smiling.*

after2_dain_11b.name: {name}
after2_dain_11b.text: *We left the gym and walked down the street.*

after2_dain_12.name: Dain
after2_dain_12.text: I lost. But wait, you're pretty good! Didn't you say you don't play sports?

after2_dain_14.name: Dain
after2_dain_14.text: *She startles.* What? Did you trick me?

after2_dain_15.name: {name}
after2_dain_15.text: Didn't hustle you. You just never asked.

after2_dain_16.name: Dain
after2_dain_16.text: *She punches my shoulder.* You fraud. — But hey, that was fun!

after2_dain_skinship_1.name: Dain
after2_dain_skinship_1.text: *Our palms meet. Dain laughs, then lets go a beat late.*

after2_dain_skinship_2.name: Dain
after2_dain_skinship_2.text: ...Oh, sorry! I do that sometimes after a game!

after2_dain_skinship_3.name: {name}
after2_dain_skinship_3.text: *Dain runs the hand that just met mine through the back of her hair.*

after2_dain_freetalk.name: Dain
after2_dain_freetalk.text: *After we step into the shop, she pushes the tteokbokki cup closer and lifts her chopsticks.* Let's see how well you handle spicy food.

after2_dain_end.name: {name}
after2_dain_end.text: *Her eyes curve into half-moons. The same eyes I saw yesterday.*

after2_dain_end_b.name: {name}
after2_dain_end_b.text: *The tteokbokki place near school. Dain blows on her tteokbokki and talks.*

after2_dain_end_2.name: Dain
after2_dain_end_2.text: Hey — you really DO know sports, huh?

after2_dain_end_2c.name: Dain
after2_dain_end_2c.text: 'A little' doesn't move like that! — Just own it, you're good.

after2_dain_end_2d.name: {name}
after2_dain_end_2d.text: You were way better than me.

after2_dain_end_3.name: Dain
after2_dain_end_3.text: *She pauses her chopsticks. Just for a moment.*

after2_dain_end_3b.name: Dain
after2_dain_end_3b.text: ...Obviously! I was on an athletic scholarship, you know!

after2_dain_end_3c.name: {name}
after2_dain_end_3c.text: *'Used to be.' Past tense. — Don't ask now.*

after2_dain_end_3e.name: Dain
after2_dain_end_3e.text: *She pushes the cup toward {name}, then deliberately asks for water in a loud voice.*

after2_dain_return.name: {name}
after2_dain_return.text: *On the way back to school, we reach the front gate.*

after2_seo_1.name: {name}
after2_seo_1.text: *The student council room. Seoyeon sits behind a pile of documents. Alone.*

after2_seo_2.name: Seoyeon
after2_seo_2.text: You actually came. — Honestly, I figured you wouldn't.

after2_seo_3.name: {name}
after2_seo_3.text: I show up when someone calls.

after2_seo_4_b.name: Seoyeon
after2_seo_4_b.text: *Instead of saying "please," she turns the clipboard toward {name}. The top of the to-do list is blank.*

after2_seo_5.name: {name}
after2_seo_5.text: You're the one who asked for help.

after2_seo_6.name: Seoyeon
after2_seo_6.text: I didn't ask. I offered you a chance.

after2_seo_6_b.name: {name}
after2_seo_6_b.text: *She has a gift for making requests sound like orders. We start sorting documents. Event budgets, club applications. Quite the pile.*

after2_seo_7.name: Seoyeon
after2_seo_7.text: *She doesn't turn away right away. Her clipboard remains pointed toward the door. Only after she hears {name}'s footsteps does she start walking.*

after2_seo_8.name: Seoyeon
after2_seo_8.text: These go by date, those by club. — Are you any good at organizing?

after2_seo_8a2.name: {name}
after2_seo_8a2.text: Not great, but not bad either.

after2_seo_8a4.name: {name}
after2_seo_8a4.text: Kind of like the way you compliment people. Vague.

after2_seo_8b.name: Seoyeon
after2_seo_8b.text: *She lifts her eyes from the documents and looks toward {name}.*

after2_seo_8b4.name: Seoyeon
after2_seo_8b4.text: It's a compliment. Take the win.

after2_seo_8b4_b.name: Seoyeon
after2_seo_8b4_b.text: *She calls it a compliment, then goes straight back to sorting the papers. The moment she turns her neck, her shoulders stiffen—just slightly.*

after2_seo_choice1.name: {name}
after2_seo_choice1.text: *Sunset streams through the window. Seoyeon lines up the edges of the papers.*
choices: The sunset's nice. — I mean the view, of course.
Does your neck hurt? Take a break.

after2_seo_sunset_joke.name: Seoyeon
after2_seo_sunset_joke.text: *She falters. Her eyes soften first behind her glasses.*

after2_seo_sunset_joke_b.name: Seoyeon
after2_seo_sunset_joke_b.text: *Even hiding the corner of her mouth behind the papers, I can tell she's smiling.*

after2_seo_sunset_react.name: Seoyeon
after2_seo_sunset_react.text: ...If you just toss lines like that out, I don't even have time to write them down.

after2_seo_sunset_react_b.name: Seoyeon
after2_seo_sunset_react_b.text: *She covers her mouth with the edge of the papers and looks out the window for a while.*

after2_seo_neck_react.name: Seoyeon
after2_seo_neck_react.text: *She rolls one shoulder and draws a small breath.*

after2_seo_neck_react_c.name: {name}
after2_seo_neck_react_c.text: *I slide one of the empty file boxes stacked nearby toward Seoyeon.*

after2_seo_neck_touch.name: Seoyeon
after2_seo_neck_touch.text: You're going to use my file box as a stand?

after2_seo_neck_high.name: {name}
after2_seo_neck_high.text: It's an empty box. You only get one neck.

after2_seo_neck_high_c.name: {name}
after2_seo_neck_high_c.text: *Seoyeon sets her papers on top of the file box. She doesn't have to tilt her head quite as far.*

after2_seo_neck_high_2_b.name: {name}
after2_seo_neck_high_2_b.text: *Seoyeon leaves the file box where it is. We go back to sorting the papers by date.*

after2_seo_neck_low.name: {name}
after2_seo_neck_low.text: *I start to offer her the file box, then stop.*

after2_seo_neck_low_b.name: {name}
after2_seo_neck_low_b.text: Never mind if you don't want it.

after2_seo_neck_low_c.name: Seoyeon
after2_seo_neck_low_c.text: *She takes the box and sets it beside the papers.*

after2_seo_neck_low_2.name: Seoyeon
after2_seo_neck_low_2.text: I'll try it when we're done.

after2_seo_9.name: {name}
after2_seo_9.text: *The sunset washes over the student council room. The paperwork is almost done.*

after2_seo_choice2.name: {name}
choices: Should I stay a bit longer? Seems like there's still some left
If we're done, I'll head out

after2_seo_stay.name: Seoyeon
after2_seo_stay.text: *She sets the documents down and gazes out the window. The sunset light touches her face.*

after2_seo_stay_2.name: Seoyeon
after2_seo_stay_2.text: ...I like how quiet it is at this hour.

after2_seo_stay_3.name: {name}
after2_seo_stay_3.text: Even the council president gets time off?

after2_seo_stay_3c.name: {name}
after2_seo_stay_3c.text: *Seoyeon's clipboard lies face down on the desk. The sunset stays on it for a long time.*

after2_seo_end.name: {name}
after2_seo_end.text: *I step out of the student council room. The sunset paints the hallway.*

after2_seo_skinship_1.name: Seoyeon
after2_seo_skinship_1.text: *She reaches out and picks a speck of dust from my collar. Her hand brushes my neck.*

after2_seo_skinship_2.name: Seoyeon
after2_seo_skinship_2.text: *Her fingers stop. She turns her head without a word. The noise in the hall suddenly sounds much louder.*

after2_seo_return.name: {name}
after2_seo_return.text: *I leave the student council room and head toward the front gate.*

after2_yuna_1.name: {name}
after2_yuna_1.text: *No message from Yuna. Still, my feet head toward the library. The folded note in my pocket brushes against the back of my hand with every step.*

after2_yuna_1_b.name: {name}
after2_yuna_1_b.text: *The annex hallway. Not a soul around. — The door to the secret reading room is slightly ajar.*

after2_yuna_2.name: {name}
after2_yuna_2.text: *I slip in quietly. Yuna is on the sofa, reading. The sunset is streaming through the window.*

after2_yuna_5.name: Yuna
after2_yuna_5.text: Do I have to call for you to show up?

after2_yuna_6.name: Yuna
after2_yuna_6.text: *She does not turn the page. Only her fingertips move.*

after2_yuna_8b.name: {name}
after2_yuna_8b.text: *The door is open, like it just happened. On the chair inside, one earbud is already lying there. Yuna silently points at the seat next to her with her chin.*

after2_yuna_8d.name: {name}
after2_yuna_8d.text: *A quiet piano song plays. The sunset is coloring the room. Yuna reads a book, and I listen to music. No words. Only the music flows low.*

after2_yuna_choice_pre1.name: Yuna
after2_yuna_choice_pre1.text: *After a long pause* ...Anyone who comes here after school.

after2_yuna_choice_pre3.name: Yuna
after2_yuna_choice_pre3.text: No one has, since that senior.

after2_yuna_choice_pre3_b.name: Yuna
after2_yuna_choice_pre3_b.text: *Yuna lifts her head and looks at {name}. The earbud cord lies frozen around her fingers.*

after2_yuna_choice.name: {name}
after2_yuna_choice.text: *The earbud cord winds once more between Yuna's fingers.*

after2_yuna_everyday_b.name: Yuna
after2_yuna_everyday_b.text: ...Come if you want. I won't stop you.

after2_yuna_everyday_react.name: Yuna
after2_yuna_everyday_react.text: ...Every day's a bit much, though. Sometimes... is okay.

after2_yuna_everyday_react_b.name: {name}
after2_yuna_everyday_react_b.text: *This doesn't sound like permission, but Yuna doesn't remove the bookmark.*

after2_yuna_quiet_react.name: Yuna
after2_yuna_quiet_react.text: *She laughs very softly. The next page turns quietly.*

after2_yuna_end.name: {name}
after2_yuna_end.text: *Dain's 'I was waiting?' and Seoyeon's 'Tell me if your plans change' are waiting on my phone. One earbud remains on the seat where Yuna and I sat side by side.*

after2_yuna_skinship_1.name: {name}
after2_yuna_skinship_1.text: *We reach for the same book — and our hands overlap.*

after2_yuna_skinship_2.name: Yuna
after2_yuna_skinship_2.text: *She doesn't pull away first. Three seconds. She lowers her gaze.*

after2_yuna_skinship_3.name: {name}
after2_yuna_skinship_3.text: *I pull my hand away. Yuna picks up the book and passes it to me without a word.*

after2_yuna_return.name: {name}
after2_yuna_return.text: *I leave the library annex. The sun is setting.*

minsu_warn_1.name: {name}
minsu_warn_1.text: *Walking home. Just past the school gate when — Minsu falls in step behind me.*

minsu_warn_1_b.name: Minsu
minsu_warn_1_b.text: *He strides up and falls into step beside me.*

minsu_warn_4_b.name: {name}
minsu_warn_4_b.text: *Sounds like a joke, but Minsu's eyes aren't in on it.*

hidden_nurse_d2_return.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d2_return.text: *I leave the nurse's office and return to the classroom, where the after-school light stretches across the desks.*

hidden_nurse_d2_freetalk.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d2_freetalk.text: *She discards the used cotton and presses the edge of the bandage once.* All done. If something besides the injury is bothering you, you can say it now.
hidden_nurse_d2_freetalk.context: It is after school on Day 2, immediately after the nurse treated an injury from PE. The student has seen how attentive the school nurse is, and their trust has grown slightly. Treatment is complete; do not invent a new injury or diagnosis. They remain a school nurse and student, with professional boundaries intact.
hidden_nurse_d2_freetalk.personality: The school nurse is practical and observant, and she softens concern with light humor. She is caring without becoming overprotective and leaves choices about health and feelings to the student.

minsu_warn_6.name: Minsu
minsu_warn_6.text: Seoyeon, Dain, Yuna — all three of them smile at you. ...Just sayin'. *He shrugs and walks ahead.*

minsu_warn_15_b.name: Dain
minsu_warn_15_b.text: Let's have another bet tomorrow! Different game!

minsu_warn_15_c.name: Seoyeon
minsu_warn_15_c.text: I'll leave the rooftop open at lunch tomorrow. Come.
